findings.headline: Charts below billed level
findings.interpretation: In a random sample, 12 of 28 charts (and 59% of the 99214/99215 claims that had charts) support a lower level than billed; the peer rate is 9%. 99215 share is 3.2x expected and 72% of the panel is low complexity.

findings.headline: Chart rule triggered
findings.interpretation: In a random sample, 5 of 30 charts support a lower level than billed. 99215 share is 3.3x expected. Smaller panel, so moderate strength.

findings.headline: Notes look inflated
findings.interpretation: 99215 share is 7.5x expected and 62% of the panel is low complexity. The charts support the billed level, but 40% of notes address fewer problems than the claimed level implies and 13% were signed late (rules 2.3), so the supportive charts are not reassuring.

findings.headline: Late-signature pattern
findings.interpretation: 99215 share is 4.3x expected. 27% of notes were signed late and 13% of charts are below the billed level. This rests on the cloned-note rule; it is not direct proof.

findings.headline: Late-signature pattern on a low-acuity panel
findings.interpretation: 99215 share is 5x expected and 78% of the panel is low complexity. 21% of 24 notes were signed late and 62% address fewer problems than billed. Records were slow and partial; the call rests on the cloned-note rule.

findings.headline: Late-signature pattern
findings.interpretation: 99215 share is 3.7x expected. 20% of notes were signed late and 27% show data review the claim does not back. This rests on the cloned-note rule.

findings.headline: Borderline late-signature pattern
findings.interpretation: 99215 share is 3.5x expected. 13% of notes were signed late, just over the 12% threshold. This is the weakest of the upcoding calls; a reviewer should weigh it carefully.

findings.headline: High share, charts support billing
findings.interpretation: 99215 share is 4.6x expected. The charts mostly support billing and the audit trail shows no bulk-created or paste-heavy notes. 53% of notes are duplicate-like (shared text), which a reviewer could look at.

findings.headline: Clean sample
findings.interpretation: No charts below the billed level, and too few 99215 visits to judge.

findings.headline: Partial records, clean
findings.interpretation: 14 of 30 charts came back and none fall below the billed level.

findings.headline: No usable charts
findings.interpretation: The office sent a billing ledger, then did not answer the follow-up. 99215 share is 7x expected. Non-response is not evidence of upcoding.

findings.headline: No response
findings.interpretation: The office did not respond. Non-response is not evidence of upcoding.
